Overview

Trabzon is a city in Trabzon with a population of 808,000. A historic Black Sea port city, known for the Sumela Monastery, lush green mountains, and hazelnut production. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
